description: This Java source file defines the DBHelper class, which manages database initialization, repository loading, migration, and related utilities for the FDroid app. It handles loading default and additional repositories, parsing XML files, and database reset operations.

classes.name: DBHelper
classes.description: A singleton class providing database management, repository loading, migration, and reset functionalities for the FDroid app.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Returns the FDroidDatabase instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: prePopulateDb
methods.description: Pre-populates the database with initial repositories and handles migration if needed.

methods.name: resetTransient
methods.description: Removes all index data related to apps from the database.

methods.name: resetRepos
methods.description: Clears all repositories and re-initializes them.

methods.name: loadInitialRepos
methods.description: Loads default and additional repositories from resources and filesystem, combining and cleaning descriptions.

methods.name: loadAdditionalRepos
methods.description: Loads additional repositories from device filesystem paths.

methods.name: parseAdditionalReposXml
methods.description: Parses an XML file to extract repository items into a list.

methods.name: getDefaultRepoAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves addresses of enabled default repositories.
